'''SupraLink''' was a type of [[link armor]] developed by [[ProTech]] thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Suits of SupraLink [[Armor/Legends|armor]] retailed for 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="TotJC" />
